facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 63°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 23 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 2 (2025)

facts.text: At Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 36.2 in, the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: 36.2 in on April 19; earlier seasons: 61.3 in (2023), 38.0 in (2024), 35.1 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 8 and May 18, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Decline Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 18, 2,118 ft above the pass; points to March 5 to May 18

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 1,138 ft above the pass; points to April 6 to June 5

evidence.name: Deer Pass
evidence.detail: melted out April 23, 998 ft above the pass; points to March 8 to May 5
